note: Curated sources, ordered by reuse tier, each read at the source on the date in its licence-read note. 'licence' records what was read, not what is assumed. 'tier' says what may be copied, and 'tiers' below defines each one. 'kind' says what the source is. Entries of kind component with a 'registry' url are searchable by scripts/find-components.js; the public directory at https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json covers the other registries.

tiers.use: The licence allows copying, changing and shipping (MIT, Apache-2.0, Unlicense). Pull a component in and change it to fit.
tiers.credit: Use is allowed with attribution (CC-BY-4.0). The entry's credit field says where the credit goes.
tiers.check-licence: A condition limits use: non-commercial only, paid above a company size, AGPL parts, no LICENSE file, no resale, or no licence stated. The entry's condition field says what it is. Tell the user before anything from it ships.
tiers.inspiration: Look for direction. Copy no code and no assets.
tiers.browse-only: robots.txt blocks Claude's crawlers. Agents never fetch it. The user browses it and pastes in what they want.

sources.notes: Meta's own design system, in beta at 0.7.14 on 2026-11-12. MIT in meta/astryx's LICENSE and on npm for core, cli and the theme packages. Its registry is shadcn-spec and in the public directory as @astryx, healthy at 98.7 with 1,004 items on 2026-11-12: 189 components, 675 blocks, 83 hooks and 57 pages, every one with a description, so search matches meaning. Item names carry their kind, so the item is component-button, not button, and its type is registry:component rather than registry:ui: the search covers both by default, but pass --type any to reach its blocks, pages and hooks. A component installs as a re-export of the npm package rather than as copied source, so taking one brings the whole system: react and react-dom >=19, @stylexjs/stylex ^0.19.0, and its own reset and stylesheet. Blocks, examples and pages do copy editable source. Its own CLI searches the same catalogue with pnpm dlx @astryxdesign/cli search <term> --json, and every command takes --json. Never run bare npx astryx: the unscoped name is an unrelated package. The 180-component and 13,000-app figures on its home page are the vendor's own and were not counted.
